text:
You need an in-person admin/personal assistant in Scarborough who can handle Microsoft 365 tasks, spreadsheets, email support, expense tracking, and basic web/hosting support. I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

On a past project, I built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. It replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one report and cut monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.

I’m comfortable creating and maintaining spreadsheets for task/project monitoring, organizing data, and supporting clear business communication. I’m available for in-person work in the Scarborough area.

Would you like someone who can also help keep your expense reports and project trackers updated on a daily basis?
